get_nested_value: get a value from a nested dictionary using dot notation path with optional default
delete_nested_value: delete a nested field from a dictionary using JSONPath-like array wildcard notation
is_nested_path: check if a path string contains dots or brackets requiring nested handling
test_get_nested_value: test get_nested_value with nested dicts, escaped dots, and missing keys returning defaults
refactor_delete_nested_value: refactor delete_nested_value to support additional JSONPath expressions beyond wildcards and indices
